import zipfile
import re
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main',
      'r': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'}

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    print("Archive entries:")
    for n in names:
        print("  ", n)

    wb = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
    rels = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
    rid_to_target = {}
    for rel in rels:
        rid_to_target[rel.get('Id')] = rel.get('Target')

    print("\nSheets:")
    for sheet in wb.find('m:sheets', NS):
        name = sheet.get('name')
        rid = sheet.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id')
        target = rid_to_target.get(rid)
        print(f"  {name!r} -> {target}")

    shared_strings = []
    if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in names:
        ss = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
        for si in ss.findall('m:si', NS):
            text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
            shared_strings.append(text)

    for sheet in wb.find('m:sheets', NS):
        name = sheet.get('name')
        rid = sheet.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id')
        target = rid_to_target.get(rid)
        if not target.startswith('xl/'):
            target = 'xl/' + target.lstrip('/')
        path = target
        print(f"\n=== Sheet {name!r} ({path}) ===")
        ws = ET.fromstring(z.read(path))
        for row in ws.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}row'):
            vals = []
            for c in row:
                ref = c.get('r')
                t = c.get('t')
                v = c.find('m:v', NS)
                raw = v.text if v is not None else None
                if t == 's' and raw is not None:
                    val = shared_strings[int(raw)]
                elif t == 'inlineStr':
                    val = ''.join(x.text or '' for x in c.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
                else:
                    val = raw
                vals.append(f"{ref}={val}")
            if vals:
                print(" | ".join(vals))

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

M = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    ws = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
    print("Formulas found:")

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

M = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'

with zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx') as z:
    ws = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))
    expenses = {}
    for row in ws.iter(f'{{{M}}}row'):
        cells = {c.get('r'): c for c in row}
        cat_cell = cells.get('A' + row.get('r'))
        item_cell = cells.get('B' + row.get('r'))
        amt_cell = cells.get('C' + row.get('r'))
        if amt_cell is not None:
            v = amt_cell.find(f'{{{M}}}v')
            if v is not None and row.get('r') not in ('23',):
                cat = cat_cell.find(f'{{{M}}}v').text if cat_cell is not None and cat_cell.find(f'{{{M}}}v') is not None else '?'
                item = item_cell.find(f'{{{M}}}v').text if item_cell is not None and item_cell.find(f'{{{M}}}v') is not None else '?'
                expenses.setdefault(cat, []).append((item, float(v.text)))

total = 0
for cat, items in expenses.items():
    subtotal = sum(x[1] for x in items)
    total += subtotal
    print(f"{cat}: {', '.join(f'{i} ({a:g})' for i, a in items)} -> subtotal {subtotal:g}")
print(f"\nTOTAL EXPENSES: {total:g}")
